sources.fact: LBBD40 Abbey Sports Centre, Axe Street is a Brownfield record with 0.35ha, public-authority ownership category and pending-decision status.
The Brownfield record supplies POINT (0.079023 51.534955) and blank geometry; this is not an application red-line or legal title polygon.
Planning Committee considered exact application 18/00331/FUL for the former Abbey Sports Centre.
18/00331/FUL proposed 170 residential units within a mixed-use scheme.
The scheme also included a two-screen cinema, office space, flexible commercial units, landscaping and public realm improvements.
Committee material includes a planning-condition schedule and explicitly preserves amendments/S106 obligations up to issue of decision.
The 2016 predecessor application was a different 150-unit PRS scheme; it is not added to the later 170-unit proposal.
November 2018 Cabinet approved revised scheme arrangements and up to £28m short-term development finance, subject to due diligence and legal documentation.
Council issue history records the former Abbey Sports Centre redevelopment as an approved key-decision workstream.
LBBD states that all sites on its Brownfield Land Register require planning permission.
The 2037 Local Plan was adopted on 18 September 2024 and is the starting point for decision-making; policy context is not a substitute for exact permission finality.
LBBD explains that permissions can carry conditions requiring later written approvals; condition processing is kept separate from proof of final scheme completion.

examples.result: The Brownfield pending-decision field is preserved rather than silently overwritten.
The earlier 150-unit scheme is not added to the 170-unit revision.
Cabinet finance approval is not treated as planning permission.
Committee conditions/S106 language is not treated as proof of final issue or discharge.
Public-authority ownership category is not converted into a named proprietor or HMLR title.
The Brownfield point is not converted into an application or title polygon.
Promotion remains zero until exact current decision finality, parcel/title relation and statutory overlays are verified.
